title: Asking the Way
label: ch:te-asking-the-way
canDo: I can ask where a place is and how to get there, follow directions with sūṭigā, eḍama vaipu and kuḍi vaipu, and talk about my ūru.

payoff.summary: Complete TE-R320-asking-the-way: ask the way, follow and give directions, and read the new letter ఊ.
